title: Director of MEP Systems
description:
The Professional Division of Spherion Mid-Ohio is partnered with an established and growing construction company in Richland County is seeking a Director of MEP Systems with base pay up to $145K + Structured Bonus Program based on skill set & experience. Come join their team!

**This is a direct hire opportunity! Never go through a temp-to-hire process. If selected, day ONE you are this companies employee!**

The Director of MEP Systems – will be responsible for managing all MEP-related estimating and preconstruction efforts by coordinating with subcontractors, reviewing bids, and participating in early project planning. This role does not involve hands-on installation; instead, it focuses on strategic oversight and subcontractor management. The Director will serve as the company's subject matter expert for MEP systems across all projects.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Develop schematic design budgets for MEP scopes using personal experience or through coordination with qualified subcontractors
  • Create detailed scopes of work and bid parameters to solicit competitive subcontractor bids
  • Evaluate and select MEP subcontractors based on best value, experience, and alignment with project needs
  • Conduct site visits on high-risk or technically complex projects to verify MEP installation quality and progress
  • Manage direct accounts and relationships with national vendors for MEP materials when self-procurement is more cost-effective
  • Participate in pre-bid site visits to gain project familiarity and ensure accurate estimations
  • Represent company in client-facing project interviews (in-person or virtual) to communicate scope strategy, technical solutions, and value engineering opportunities for MEP systems
Qualifications:
  • High School Diploma or GED; Mechanical/Electrical Engineering degree preferred, or 10+ years of field experience required
  • Proven expertise in MEP estimating and preconstruction for commercial construction projects
  • 7-10+ years of experience in the construction industry, preferably with MEP focus
  • Strong knowledge of MEP systems, subcontractor management, and vendor coordination
  • Ability to interact and communicate with clients
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel
  • Experience working with estimating in Sage software and CM tools a plus
  • Willing to travel to job sites in multiple states, including overnight stays as needed
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment
Preferred Skills but not required – Nice to have:
  • Mechanical/Electrical Engineering degree
What's in it for you?:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Short Term/Long Term Disability
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Health Savings Account
  • ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan)
  • 401K -match up to 4%
  • PTO
  • Six paid company holidays
  • Company vehicle provided
Does this sound like the opportunity you have been seeking? Apply with resume today!

title: Project Engineer
description:
The Professional Division of Spherion Mid-Ohio is partnered with an established and growing construction company in Gunnison CO is seeking a Project Engineer with base pay up to $80K + Bonus based on skill set & experience. Come join their team!

**This is a direct hire opportunity! Never go through a temp-to-hire process. If selected, day ONE you are this companies employee!**

The Project Engineer – supports project-level engineering and administrative functions. This position will work closely with the Project Manager and field operations teams to ensure effective communication, scheduling, risk management, and successful execution of construction projects.

  • Develop schedules, phasing plans, and logistics strategies

title: Production Supervisor
description:
Job Title: Production Supervisor 25-00970

The Professional & Direct Hire Division of Spherion Mid-Ohio is seeking a Second Shift Production Supervisor in Ashland, OH to join our client's team! This is a direct-hire leadership opportunity with pay up to $75K and excellent benefits starting on day one. Play a key role in leading a production team, driving improvements, and supporting a long-standing manufacturer with global stability and local growth.
This is a Direct Hire opportunity! Never go through a temp-to-hire process. If selected, day ONE you are this company's employee!
As a Second Shift Production Supervisor, you'll oversee 8 departments directly (with some additional oversight of Maintenance and Quality staff). This is a hands-on role, you'll spend most of your time on the production floor ensuring safety, productivity, and team development.
Job Responsibilities
  • Supervise, coordinate, and support 30–35 employees, ensuring safety guidelines, SOPs, and company policies are consistently followed.
  • Lead daily shift operations by reviewing schedules, assigning work, and aligning labor to meet production goals and deadlines.
  • Be a hands on leader, spending most time on the floor, promoting safety, monitoring production, and assisting when/where needed.
  • Communicate Client needs, assist with onboarding new hires, and evaluate employees to ensure proper placement and performance.
  • Maintain accurate time, attendance, and production records; approve timecards/vacations, and manage disciplinary actions.
  • Conduct shift meetings ( "Shop Talks”) to communicate goals, motivate employees, and resolve issues.
  • Use the CISPRO ERP system to track orders.
  • Partner with department leads and collaborate with Accounts Payable and Purchasing to resolve customer issues.
  • Recommend and implement improvements to production processes, SOPs, lean practices, and equipment performance.
  • Support Preventative Maintenance programs, quality inspection requirements, and continuous improvement initiatives using 80/20 toolbox.
Qualifications
  • Minimum of 2–3 years supervisory experience in manufacturing or related industry.
  • Strong experience with SOPs, safety procedures, and lean manufacturing practices.
  • Mechanical aptitude; hydraulics and pneumatics experience a plus.
  • Strong leadership and people management skills
  • Ability to interpret production schedules, safety guidelines, and technical instructions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and ERP systems
  • Associate's degree or technical training preferred but not required (experience may substitute).
What's in it for you?
With about 170 employees across three locations, this client offers the stability and benefits of a global organization with over 30,000 employees, potential for growth and advancement, while maintaining the personal, close-knit environment of a smaller company.
  • Compensation: $65,000–$75,000 annually
  • Benefits start day one , including:
    • Medical/Dental/Vision
    • 401K with Company Match
    • PTO: 2 weeks' vacation + 5 sick days
  • Schedule: 2:45 PM – 11:15 PM, Monday–Friday
Ready to take the next step?
Apply today or reach out to Corinne Fanello at CFanello@spherionohio.com to learn more about this exciting opportunity!

title: Bakery Packager
description:
Job Title: Bakery Packager - 21-13853

Company or Role Overview:
Join a dynamic team at a well-known bakery in Ashland, Ohio, where you'll play a crucial role in packaging a variety of delicious cookies. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to the final stages of the production process in a supportive and engaging environment.

Get an inside look at what it's like working at Campbell's Snacks in Ashland!
Inside Video look: Working at Campbell's Snacks In Ashland

Available Shifts:
  • 1st Shift: 6:50 AM - 3:00 PM
  • 2nd Shift: 2:50 PM - 11:00 PM
  • 3rd Shift: 10:45 PM - 7:00 AM
  • Schedule: Monday - Friday with overtime on Saturdays.
Pay Rate:
$15.00 - $16.50 per hour (includes shift differential), with the opportunity to earn a weekly perfect attendance bonus, recognizing your commitment and reliability.

Work Environment:
Experience a bright, clean, and climate-controlled facility where teamwork and a positive atmosphere are valued. This is an easy-to-learn position with a steady pace, fostering a fun work environment that prioritizes work-life balance for all team members.

Job Description:
As a Bakery Packager, you will be an integral part of our packaging team, responsible for:
  • Collaborating effectively with team members to package various types of cookies according to quality standards.
  • Maintaining a consistent work pace in a steady-paced production environment.
  • (Previous warehouse experience is a plus but not a requirement - comprehensive training is provided)
  • Engaging in continuous movement, including standing, walking, lifting, and bending, throughout your shift to ensure efficient packaging.
Requirements:
We are looking for reliable and enthusiastic individuals who demonstrate:
  • Consistent and dependable attendance.
  • A positive and team-oriented attitude.
  • Excellent hand-eye coordination to ensure accurate and efficient packaging.
  • The ability to safely lift and maneuver up to 50 pounds.
  • A strong commitment to dependability and punctuality.
  • Willingness to adhere to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs), including restrictions on jewelry, piercings, nail polish, false nails, and false eyelashes to maintain food safety standards.
No high school diploma is required for this entry-level position!

Benefits:
As a valued member of the team, you will have access to a comprehensive benefits package, including:
  • 3 unpaid sick days to provide flexibility when needed.
  • Access to the company store for discounted products.
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance available from day one through Spherion.
  • Generous Referral Bonuses for bringing in talented individuals to our team.
  • Opportunities for growth and development through Scholarship Programs.
  • Five days of Paid Time Off to enjoy personal time and recharge.
  • Recognition and appreciation through National Staffing Week Gifts.
  • Fun Giveaways and Incentive Programs to celebrate the team's success.
  • Weekly Pay, ensuring you receive your earnings promptly.
Ready to join our amazing team and contribute to the sweet success of the bakery?
